findings.finding: the reviewer stage's failure mode is OVER-REWRITING: fixing surfaced findings by restating/reorganizing the whole bill breaks clean sentences (the duty_pricing residual is introduced post-fix)
findings.countermeasure: a DIFF-MINIMIZATION clause: change ONLY the sentences the findings touch; carry every other sentence of the original verbatim
findings.anti_pattern: MORE derivation rules — m1_duty_rule and m4_m1m2 INTRODUCED defects (1/12 each): derive-or-delete wording makes the reviewer ADD duty figures to bills that had none
